findings.evidence: Basic.lean:143 `have hn : F.n ≠ 0 := fun h => by simpa [h] using F.timelike`; no other declaration in the file exposes this.
findings.fix: Factor it out as `theorem n_ne_zero : F.n ≠ 0 := fun h => by simpa [h] using F.timelike` next to `energy_n_pos`, and use it here.
findings.issue: `F.n ≠ 0` is proved inline inside `spatial_eq_self_iff`; it is a basic reusable fact about every frame that the Breit-frame existence/uniqueness and hemisphere material will need again.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:229-232 and :196-197; `spatialNorm` is a `def` (line 190) with `spatialNorm_def` stated by `rfl` at 193 but unused in these proofs.
findings.fix: State the reusable fact explicitly, e.g. `theorem spatialNorm_pos_iff (p) : 0 < F.spatialNorm p ↔ 0 < -g (F.spatial p) (F.spatial p) := by rw [spatialNorm_def, Real.sqrt_pos]` (or `spatialNorm_ne_zero_iff`), and derive `hpos` from it in `cosAngle_self`; prove `spatialNorm_nonneg` via `rw [spatialNorm_def]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _`. Downstream Durham/genKt distances divide by spatial norms and will need the iff anyway.
findings.issue: `Real.sqrt_pos.mp ((F.spatialNorm_nonneg p).lt_of_ne' hp)` only typechecks because unification delta-unfolds the `spatialNorm` wrapper to `Real.sqrt (-g _ _)`; the file provides `spatialNorm_def` precisely to avoid this but does not use it. The same implicit unfolding occurs in `spatialNorm_nonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg _` (line 196).

summary: Proofs are short and lean on simp/field_simp/ring appropriately, but one reusable fact (n ≠ 0) is buried inline and cosAngle_self relies on spatialNorm unfolding definitionally to Real.sqrt rather than on an explicit lemma.
